title: Windows: a service installed from an SSH session cannot register its logon task
goal: Windows: a service installed from an SSH session cannot register its logon task
acceptance: Test committed failing first: `windowsServiceUser` gives `COMPUTERNAME\\user` for a local account (also when USERDOMAIN is WORKGROUP) and `USERDOMAIN\\user` when USERDNSDOMAIN is set; on Tabgha an SSH install registers the task.

Amended 2026-11-25 (requirement deliberately changed by B-087, closed by PR #612/#613): Windows refuses install, start and update applied from an SSH session, so the live part is now: on Tabgha, in an SSH session (USERDOMAIN=WORKGROUP), windowsServiceUser names an account that maps to a SID, and it is the account of the registered NERV Agency task.
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: 2026-11-25 read-only probe on Tabgha over SSH from a temporary clone of main fa9ab0b (deleted afterwards)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: one account rule and a test. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-25 after a read-only live probe on Tabgha (about 0.25 h, stated).
